provenance.rationale: Switched the synchronous single-thread harness from process CPU to calling-thread CPU after unchanged renderer code produced 0.185 ms and 0.547 ms combined p95 in consecutive runs while p50 stayed stable, demonstrating contamination from unrelated process threads. Thread-CPU calibration is recorded in the final PR validation. The five-batch median, 1.20x regression ratio, 0.05 ms noise allowance, and hard-coded 4 ms stage and 8 ms combined ceilings remain authoritative.
